title: CVE-2022-21445: Oracle ADF Faces Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability

title: CVE-2024-27348: Apache HugeGraph-Server Improper Access Control Vulnerability

title: CVE-2016-3714: ImageMagick Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
summary: ImageMagick contains an improper input validation vulnerability that affects the EPHEMERAL, HTTPS, MVG, MSL, TEXT, SHOW, WIN, and PLT coders. This allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via shell metacharacters in a crafted image.

title: CVE-2024-7262: Kingsoft WPS Office Path Traversal Vulnerability
